title: Lythara, the Wayward Spear Boss Guide: Ground Hazards, Stampede and +40 Spirit
summary: Path of Exile 2 Interlude 3 (Kriar Village) boss guide: persistent ground hazard zones, Projectile Nova, Boar Stampede, and the Gemcrust Skull for +40 maximum Spirit.
description: Beat Lythara, the Wayward Spear in Kriar Village (Interlude 3). Survive long-lasting ground hazards, the Stampede, and claim the Gemcrust Skull for +40 Spirit.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team

sections.title: Remember These First
sections.callout: Lythara, the Wayward Spear is the Interlude 3 Kriar Village boss whose kill drops the Gemcrust Skull, granting +40 maximum Spirit — one-time.
calloutDetail: Ground hazard zones persist a long time and fire Projectile Novas; pre-position to a clean side before they overlap.
A Stampede (charging boar) telegraphs with a wind-up; move sideways, do not run along its path.
The Gemcrust Skull drops on the ground; pick it up AND right-click it — and watch a full backpack, which can swallow the drop.

sections.title: Top search questions: hazards, Skull, Spirit

items.question: Where is Lythara in Kriar Village?
answer: Clear the narrow linear village to the boss arena at the end, before the Glacial Tarn entrance. Defeating her opens the Glacial Tarn.

items.question: Why do the ground hazards last so long?
answer: Her poison pools and lightning / chaos storms are persistent area-denial that clutter the small arena. Re-position before they overlap rather than fighting in them.

items.question: Why didn't my Spirit increase after the kill?
answer: The +40 only applies after you pick up the Gemcrust Skull AND right-click it. If your backpack was full at the drop, the Skull may have vanished — check extra storage tabs.

items.question: Is the boss not on the minimap?
answer: Sources confirm Kriar Village has a Waypoint and Lythara is the zone boss; reports of a 'not on map' state are unverified for 0.5.4. Reach the arena at the end of the village.

steps.label: Reach Interlude 3
body: Finish Act 4 'The Search', talk to the Hooded One, and choose to travel to Mount Kriar.

steps.label: Through the Glade and Ashen Forest
body: Enter The Glade, cross Ashen Forest (no waypoint) to the far side, then enter Kriar Village.

steps.label: Clear to the boss arena
body: Push through the linear village to the arena at the end; defeating Lythara opens the Glacial Tarn.

sections.title: Encounter Overview
paragraphs: Lythara, the Wayward Spear is a high-pressure Interlude boss fought in a small arena. The fight is continuous but escalates with threshold-based Wildwood Wisp empowerments rather than discrete phases.
The defining threat is area denial: poison pools and lightning / chaos storms linger, and her spear throws spawn storms that keep firing projectiles. Positioning is the whole fight.
bullets: Persistent ground hazards, not short bursts.
Wildwood Wisps empower her if she touches one — fight away from them.
The Gemcrust Skull is the +40 Spirit reward.

sections.title: Arena State and Ground Hazards
paragraphs: The arena starts clean, then Lythara lays down ground hazard zones that persist for a long time. Thunder Spear and Chaos Throw leave lightning / chaos storms that periodically fire additional projectiles.

As her HP drops, Wildwood Wisps (Wild / Vivid / Primal) spawn; if she touches one she is empowered (e.g. Frenzied Boar stampede, Raging Ox). Guides advise fighting her away from wisps and resetting at the checkpoint if she gets 2+ buffs.
bullets: Clean ground = set up your damage window.
Hazard spawns = pre-move to a clean side.
Overlapping hazards = abandon damage, rebuild safe space.
Stampede = sideways move, not along the charge path.

phases.label: Phase 1 — Continuous Fight (Escalating)
phases.trigger: Fight start in the Kriar Village arena.
notes: No hard phase split; wisp empowerments raise pressure as HP drops. Aim to burst her before 2+ buffs.

attacks.name: Serpent's Bite
telegraph: Unblockable spear thrust that summons serpents in a line.

attacks.name: Thunder Spear
telegraph: Raises spear, throws it; on impact it splits into returning projectiles and a lightning storm.
responses: Avoid walls, keep moving out of the storm.

attacks.name: Chaos Throw
telegraph: Charges spear with chaos, throws; splits into bolts + a whirling storm of orbs.
responses: Stay off the walls; clear the storm.

attacks.name: Toxic Spray
telegraph: Jumps back, fires poison bolts leaving persistent pools.

sections.title: Reward Claim Flow — Gemcrust Skull to +40 Spirit
paragraphs: Kill Lythara; the Gemcrust Skull drops on the ground. Using it also grants a Level 14 Uncut Spirit Gem.

Pick it up — and watch a full backpack, which can make the Skull vanish on drop. Then RIGHT-CLICK it in inventory to apply +40 maximum Spirit. If you already earned it on a pre-0.3.0 character, it will not drop again.
bullets: Pick it up (free backpack space first).
Right-click the Skull -> +40 Spirit (+ Lvl 14 Uncut Spirit Gem).
One-time; can be reserved by Persistent Skills.

rewards.label: Gemcrust Skull
notes: Grants +40 to maximum Spirit and a Level 14 Uncut Spirit Gem. Right-click to use. One-time.

rewards.label: +40 Maximum Spirit
notes: Applied only after right-clicking the Skull.

items.label: Backpack space
checks: Free several slots before the kill.
items.why: A full backpack can swallow the Skull drop.

items.label: Movement
checks: A movement skill for hazard dodging.

items.label: Wisp awareness
checks: Plan to fight away from wisps.

sections.title: Build Considerations
paragraphs: Lythara punishes any build that must stand still. The fight is a positioning puzzle around persistent storms, so mobility and burst beat sustained DPS.
Ranged kits can kite the storms; melee must use the clean-ground windows between throws. Avoid the Wildwood Wisps entirely — an empowered Lythara is a different, harder fight.
bullets: Ranged: kite the storms, peek damage between.

entries.question: Lythara not dropping the Gemcrust Skull / marked done
summary: Players killed her several times with no Skull; one cause is a pre-0.3.0 character that already earned the +40 from Act 3 Cruel, so the map shows it done and no new Skull drops.
editorialAnalysis: The Skull is a one-time campaign drop. A full backpack at drop can also swallow it (one player found it in 'extra storage').
officialAnswer: Pick up the Gemcrust Skull after the kill; if earned pre-0.3.0 it will not drop again.

entries.question: Lythara boss fight: no Spirit reward, no completion
summary: Multiple players: 'fought 3 times, no reward'; 'inventory was full and the reward disappeared'. One resolved by finding it in extra storage.
editorialAnalysis: Confirms the backpack-full drop-loss failure mode. The +40 is applied only on use.
officialAnswer: The Gemcrust Skull must be picked up and right-clicked to grant +40 Spirit.

problems.symptom: I cannot find the boss arena
directAnswer: Clear the linear Kriar Village to the end; the arena is before the Glacial Tarn entrance. Defeating her opens the Tarn.

problems.symptom: The ground hazards keep killing me
directAnswer: They persist by design. Pre-move to a clean side before they overlap; do not fight inside the storms.
checks: Are you standing in a pool/storm?

problems.symptom: Spirit didn't increase after the kill
directAnswer: Pick up the Gemcrust Skull AND right-click it. If your backpack was full at the drop, check extra storage tabs — the Skull may have landed there.
